void motion_compensation_mmx(uint8_t* dst, const uint8_t* src, int stride, int h,
                             int ox, int oy, int dxx, int dxy, int dyx, int dyy,
                             int shift, int r, int width, int height) {
    if (oy <= -height || oy >= height || ox <= -width || ox >= width) {
        motion_compensation_c(dst, src, stride, h, ox, oy, dxx, dxy, dyx, dyy,
                              shift, r, width, height);
        return;
    }

    __asm__ volatile (
        "pushl %%ebx\n\t"
        "pushl %%esi\n\t"
        "pushl %%edi\n\t"
        "movl %2, %%esi\n\t"
        "movl %3, %%edi\n\t"
        "movl %4, %%ecx\n\t"
        "1:\n\t"
        "movq (%esi), %%mm0\n\t"
        "movq 8(%esi), %%mm1\n\t"
        "punpcklbw %%mm7, %%mm0\n\t"
        "punpcklbw %%mm7, %%mm1\n\t"
        "movq %%mm0, (%edi)\n\t"
        "movq %%mm1, 8(%edi)\n\t"
        "addl $16, %%esi\n\t"
        "addl $16, %%edi\n\t"
        "decl %%ecx\n\t"
        "jnz 1b\n\t"
        "emms\n\t"
        "popl %%edi\n\t"
        "popl %%esi\n\t"
        "popl %%ebx"
        :
        : "S"(src), "D"(dst), "g"(src), "g"(dst), "g"(h)
        : "memory");
}
